2608.25100.title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
2608.25100.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful but limited by static parametric knowledge that becomes outdated once pretraining ends. Knowledge editing addresses this problem by updating model behavior on target facts without full retraining. In particular, in-context knowledge editing has gained attention because it is training-free and readily applicable to black-box LLMs. Recent reinforcement learning (RL)-based approaches improve over fixed retrieval strategies by adapting prompt construction to the quantity-quality trade-off. Despite initial success, they fail to model the prompt as a structured entity under the distinct and often competing objectives of reliability, generality, and specificity. Previous methods largely optimize a single objective and make decisions over only part of the prompt construction process, thereby overlooking both the balance of different objectives and the global organization of demonstrations. We propose Multi-Objective In-context Knowledge Editing (MO-IKE), a multi-objective RL algorithm that formulates prompt construction for in-context knowledge editing as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. MO-IKE trains a dynamic retriever to optimize competing objectives in knowledge editing, enabling more balanced and globally coherent prompt construction. On Llama-3.2, MO-IKE improves edit success (reliability) from 85.0% to 92.0%, paraphrase consistency (generality) from 77% to 79%, while increasing retention rate (specificity) by 23.0% compared to prior RL-based methods.
2608.25100.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）功能強大，但受到靜態參數知識的限制，這些知識在預訓練結束後會變得過時。知識編輯通過在不進行全面再訓練的情況下更新模型行為來解決這個問題，針對特定事實進行調整。特別是，上下文知識編輯引起了關注，因為它不需要訓練，並且可以輕鬆應用於黑箱LLMs。最近基於強化學習（RL）的方法通過調整提示構建來改善固定檢索策略，以平衡數量和質量的權衡。儘管初步成功，但它們未能將提示建模為一個結構化實體，這在可靠性、通用性和特異性這三個不同且常常相互競爭的目標下顯得尤為重要。以往的方法主要優化單一目標，並僅在提示構建過程的部分進行決策，因此忽視了不同目標之間的平衡以及示範的全局組織。我們提出了多目標上下文知識編輯（MO-IKE），這是一種多目標RL算法，將上下文知識編輯的提示構建公式化為約束馬爾可夫決策過程。MO-IKE訓練一個動態檢索器，以優化知識編輯中的競爭目標，使提示構建更加平衡且全局一致。在Llama-3.2上，MO-IKE將編輯成功率（可靠性）從85.0%提高到92.0%，將改寫一致性（通用性）從77%提高到79%，同時將保留率（特異性）提高了23.0%，相比於之前基於RL的方法。
